Step-In Burst.name: Step-In Burst
Step-In Burst.description: The user closes the distance with a quick step and releases the Quirk at point-blank range as the front foot lands. Deals the Quirk's own damage type (bludgeoning damage from a body-strengthening Quirk) and pushes the opponent back out of arm's reach and off balance: they cannot counterattack on their next action. Strain: light.
